title: Positions inside the coordinate system's area of use
description: Each node lies inside the declared coordinate system's area of use as coordinate-systems.json records it from the EPSG Dataset: for a geographic system west to east and south to north in degrees (across 180 degrees when west exceeds east), for a projected one its native extent in its own units; edges are inside, a non-finite coordinate is outside. Nodes: grid cell centres (missing cells excluded), points, traces, or a feature's positions (one failure per feature). An unknown or uncatalogued system, or unknown axes, does not apply (no-column).

words.template: {count} positions lie outside the coordinate system's area of use, the first at {first}.
